hoaxes.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 can now design protein shakes tailored to your gym schedule
hoaxes.truth: Made up. OpenAI says GPT-6 designed protein sequences that showed binding to five targets in lab tests.

hoaxes.title: Cinemas showing Focker-In-Law add seats that place your in-laws one row behind you
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Focker-In-Law opened in cinemas on November 25, with Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro returning.

hoaxes.title: Mario Kart World's free update adds a course set inside a Black Friday checkout queue
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Mario Kart World's free update adds eight new remixed courses, GAMINGbible reports.

hoaxes.title: SpaceX and Tesla reportedly plan a car with a roof that doubles as a launch pad
hoaxes.truth: Made up. SpaceX and Tesla have reportedly named directors to negotiate a possible merger.
